verse.verse_1: By the night as it veils [the earth] in darkness,
verse.verse_2: and by the day as it appears radiantly,
verse.verse_3: and by the creation of the male and the female.
verse.verse_4: O men, you truly strive towards the most diverse ends!
verse.verse_5: As for one who gives [to others] and fears [God],
verse.verse_6: and believes in the truth of what is right,
verse.verse_7: We will pave his way to ease.
verse.verse_8: But as for one who is miserly and unheeding,
verse.verse_10: We shall pave his way to hardship,
verse.verse_11: nor will his wealth profit him when he falls [into the pit].
verse.verse_12: Surely, it is for Us to provide guidance --
verse.verse_13: and to Us belongs the Hereafter as well as the present world --
verse.verse_14: I have warned you then about a raging Fire:
verse.verse_15: none shall enter it but the most wicked,
verse.verse_16: who denied [the truth], and turned away.
verse.verse_17: One who fears God shall be kept away from it --
verse.verse_18: one who gives his wealth to become purified,
verse.verse_19: and owes no favour to anyone, which is to be repaid,
verse.verse_20: acting only for the sake of his Lord the Most High --
verse.verse_21: and before long he will be well satisfied.
